water_volume_m3.basis: illustrative: emulator_inputs range widened +-10% per side (m5_specs.md §5.2)

breach_width_m.basis: illustrative: emulator_inputs range widened +-10% per side

failure_time_s.basis: illustrative: emulator_inputs range widened +-10% per side (negative lower bound is a known artifact of uniform widening near zero; sampling clips at 0)

inundated_area_m2.basis: illustrative; low = HIGH-zone area, high = HIGH+POSSIBLE-zone area (docs/impact_outputs.md population convention)

max_depth_m.basis: illustrative; at the breach cell, actually the 5th/95th percentile (see interval_label_p5_p95_not_p10_p90 caveat)

max_velocity_ms.basis: illustrative; 1.6*sqrt(depth) of the breach-cell depth percentiles above

peak_discharge_m3s.basis: illustrative continuity estimate (velocity x depth x channel width) at the breach-cell depth percentiles

arrival_s.basis: illustrative travel-time proxy; low = fastest (P95 depth), high = slowest (P5 depth) -- see far_field_arrival_travel_time_proxy caveat

overall.reason_key: Low (C: only 57% of Monte Carlo samples fall inside the trained V_w/B_ave/T_f design box)

extent.reason_key: Low (C: only 57% of Monte Carlo samples fall inside the trained V_w/B_ave/T_f design box)

provenance.note: 200-sample Monte Carlo ensemble over Teesta's own emulator_inputs ranges widened +-10% per side (m5_specs.md §5.2), computed by gen_preview_assets.py:gen_confidence_ensemble(); see frontend/src/data/preview/generated/teesta_confidence.json for the full computation (per-cell P/median/P5/P95, per-POI results, the training design, and the HIGH-to-POSSIBLE downgrade example at row 26 col 18, chainage ~10,532 m, P(depth>0.3m)=0.515, flagged for being highly sensitive to breach width). Confidence's 'depth'/'velocity' outputs are separately capped at MODERATE (not LOW) because their own weakest link is the placeholder-inputs cap, not coverage -- 'overall'/'extent'/'arrival' are already LOW from coverage alone, so the cap does not raise them; this reflects m5_specs.md §6's per-output confidence, not a single site-wide number.
